title: Director weekly prep scratchpad — exec staff sync
content:
Personal scratchpad for this week
Purpose: quick talking points for exec staff + 1:1 prep, plus a running action list to capture follow-ups and owners. Keep high level — don’t rehearse verbatim.

Top priorities to surface (2–3):
- Dedicated capacity renewal guidance: need clear renewal offer by EOW (ask finance + sales for final pricing bands).
- Private deployments pilot: unblock on validation tests for FedRAMP partner (Marco) — test failures on pkg v2.3 (KV cache edge case).
- Reliability SLOs: discuss proposal to widen token-latency SLO window from p95 to p99 for background workloads to reduce cost.

Notes for Monday exec staff (20–25m):
- Quick round (1 min each): any red-blockers?
- Sales/opps: renewals > $250k — Lena to call out four at-risk accounts. (Expected ask: sales support for technical deep-dive.)
- Ops: incident recap (Mar 8): root cause, mitigation, next preventive steps — Tom owning postmortem timeline.
- Product: Decide on rollout plan for streaming improvements (canary cadence + fallback rules). Need sign-off on automatic fallback to smaller model when latency spikes.
- Risk/compliance: update on private deployment KMS integration timeline for customer X.

1:1 with CEO (30m) — focus + asks:
- Vision check: are we comfortable pushing more of marketing/benchmarks out next quarter? Pro: helps PLG. Con: risks overpromising perf.
- Ask: greenlight a small PR budget to publish third-party latency/price-per-token benchmarks (approx $12k).
- People: hiring ask for +2 infra SREs (Q2 headcount) — prepare justification with outage cost calc.
- Feedback loop: get CEO preference on how risk decisions get escalated (phone vs thread).

1:1 with CTO (30m) — deep dive tech blockers:
- Marco: status update on private deployment smoke tests (INF-243). Key failure mode: shard rehydration + cold start KV cache mismatch. Wants 48h to reproduce and patch.
- Runtime PR (runtimes/#789): review perf numbers; are they from representative workloads? Ask: replicate with seq len distribution from customer B.
- Decision needed: proceed with aggressive quantization profile plan for Dedicated customers vs wait for more evals — risk of quality regressions.

Action items (running list) — capture owners + tentative due dates:
- [ ] Marco: finish private deployment repro and upload test artifacts (due 2026-03-15).
- [ ] Lena: compile renewals risk matrix + recommended action for top 4 (due 2026-03-13).
- [ ] Tom: draft incident postmortem outline and share with exec by 2026-03-16.
- [ ] Product (Priya): prepare one-slide on streaming fallback UX + proposal for canary policy (due 2026-03-14).
- [ ] Finance (Ben): run cost model showing impact of shifting p95->p99 SLO on Dedicated capacity (due 2026-03-17).
- [ ] Me (Aisha): follow up with legal on contract language for Private pilot (KMS/HSM clauses) and get redlines (due 2026-03-18).

Open questions / parking lot:
- Do we want to offer a ‘fallback to cheaper model’ feature as default or opt-in for Dedicated customers? (ops cost vs customer surprise)
- How aggressive should we be with public benchmarks vs waiting for more reproducibility?
- Longer-term: org structure for platform vs runtime teams — do we keep them split or move under a single infra org? Put on 1:1 with VP Eng next week.

Quick references I might need in meeting:
- Renewals list: slack-thread #sales-renewals (pin Lena’s note)
- Incident timeline: INF-243 ticket (linked above)
- Private deployment checklist: Confluence link (linked above)

Tone notes for meeting: stay decisive and avoid engineering minutiae in exec staff; escalate only when decision required. Use the 2-min rule for tangents — if >2 min, move to follow-up.

Notes to self (shorthand):
- If CEO asks about hiring timeline: push for Q2 hires; show cost of current oncall burnout and one recent incident as example.
- If CTO pushes to delay benchmarks: offer phased publish (internal -> trusted partners -> public).

Post-meeting follow-ups (capture immediately after call):
- Write a short digest in #exec with decisions and owners (do within 2 hours).
- Update Confluence action tracker + tag owners.
- Schedule 15m sync with Marco if repro not resolved by 2026-03-15.

Rough timeline for this doc:
- Finalize briefing notes tonight (quick edit).
- Print/leave on desk for 1:1s.

Random scratch items (ignore unless asked):
- Quick metric: weekly hosted API revenue growth 6% (confirm with finance).
- Consider running a customer advisory call about Dedicated pricing in April.

-- end of scratchpad --
